# Mod Manifest

Each mod's folder contains a `mod.toml` file: the mod's manifest, which Lustral reads to identify the mod, its
requirements and how to load it. **The SDK generates it from the project file on every build**; set
[SDK properties](./sdk-properties) rather than editing the manifest. This page describes the format for reference and
for tools that produce mods without the SDK.

```toml
# Generated by Lustral.Sdk from BetterHud.csproj. Do not edit; changes are overwritten on build.
id = "you.betterhud"
name = "Better HUD"
version = "1.2.0"
assembly = "BetterHud.dll"
description = "A cleaner HUD with an FPS counter."
authors = ["you"]
license = "MIT"

[links]
website = "https://example.com/betterhud"
source = "https://github.com/you/betterhud"

[requires]
lustral = "^0.1"
backends = ["mono"]
games = [
    { name = "Lethal Company", developer = "Zeekerss", versions = ["v72*", "v73*"] },
]

[dependencies]
"someone.uikit" = "^1.2"

[optional-dependencies]
"someone.extras" = "*"

[incompatibilities]
"someone.otherhud" = "*"

[update]
source = "github:you/betterhud"
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | SDK property | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | String, required | `ModId` | Lowercase letters and digits, separated by single `.`, `-` or `_`. |
| `name` | String | `ModName` | Defaults to the ID. |
| `version` | String, required | `Version` | A [semantic version](./versions). |
| `kind` | `"mod"` or `"library"` | `ModKind` | Defaults to `"mod"`. |
| `assembly` | String | (the project's assembly) | The assembly containing the mod's `Mod` class, relative to the mod's folder. Optional for libraries without one. |
| `exports` | Array of strings | `ModExport` items | The assemblies a library exposes to its dependents, by name. |
| `description` | String | `Description` | |
| `authors` | String or array | `Authors` | |
| `credits` | String | `ModCredits` | |
| `license` | String | `PackageLicenseExpression` | An SPDX license expression. |
| `load-order` | Integer | `ModLoadOrder` | Defaults to 0; among mods that do not depend on each other, lower values load first. |
| `color` | String | `ModColor` | A Unity color name or `#rrggbb`. |

## [links]

Named HTTP(S) links shown with the mod's details: `website` (`PackageProjectUrl`), `source` (`RepositoryUrl`), and any
links defined with `ModLink` items.

## [requires]

| Key | Type | SDK property |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lustral` | Version range | `ModLustralVersion` |
| `unity` | Version range | `ModUnityVersion` |
| `backends` | Array of `"mono"`, `"il2cpp"` | `ModBackends` |
| `platforms` | Array of `"windows"`, `"linux"`, `"macos"`, optionally with `-x64`, `-x86`, `-arm64` | `ModPlatforms` |
| `processes` | Array of executable names | `ModProcesses` |
| `games` | Array of `{ name, developer, versions }` | `ModGame` items |

An omitted key imposes no requirement. See [Compatibility Requirements](/developer-guide/compatibility) for how
requirements are evaluated.

## [dependencies], [optional-dependencies], [incompatibilities]

Tables mapping mod IDs to [version ranges](./versions). A mod cannot appear in both `dependencies` and
`optional-dependencies`, or be both a dependency and an incompatibility. See
[Mod Dependencies](/developer-guide/dependencies).

## [update]

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | `github:owner/repository`, or the HTTPS address of a JSON feed. |
| `asset` | For GitHub sources: the release file to download, with `*` wildcards. |

See [Publishing and Updates](/developer-guide/publishing).

## Unknown Keys

Lustral ignores unknown keys, so manifests written by newer SDK versions can still be read; their `lustral` range
determines whether the installed Lustral version is supported. A manifest that is not valid TOML, or that violates the
rules above, prevents the mod from loading, and the reason is logged.
